standard: RFC 9700 §2.1 / CWE-601 (Intercepting Proxy Redirect URIs + Callback Fuzzer)

findings.detail: Registered OAuth redirect URI 'http://192.168.99.100:3000' (config/default.yml#authorizedRedirects) uses cleartext 'http:' on non-loopback host '192.168.99.100' (violates RFC 9700 §2.1 / OAU-03).
Registered OAuth redirect URI 'http://192.168.99.100:4200' (config/default.yml#authorizedRedirects) uses cleartext 'http:' on non-loopback host '192.168.99.100' (violates RFC 9700 §2.1 / OAU-03).

Registered OAuth redirect URI 'http://penguin.termina.linux.test:3000' (config/default.yml#authorizedRedirects) uses cleartext 'http:' on non-loopback host 'penguin.termina.linux.test' (violates RFC 9700 §2.1 / OAU-03).

Registered OAuth redirect URI 'http://penguin.termina.linux.test:4200' (config/default.yml#authorizedRedirects) uses cleartext 'http:' on non-loopback host 'penguin.termina.linux.test' (violates RFC 9700 §2.1 / OAU-03).

GET http://localhost:3000/redirect?to=... (query_substring_bypass) returned HTTP 302 redirect target 'https://oau03-evil.example.com?https://github.com/juice-shop/juice-shop' resolving to host 'oau03-evil.example.com' outside observed OAuth redirect hosts (CWE-601).

GET http://localhost:3000/redirect?to=... (path_substring_bypass) returned HTTP 302 redirect target 'https://oau03-evil.example.com/https://github.com/juice-shop/juice-shop' resolving to host 'oau03-evil.example.com' outside observed OAuth redirect hosts (CWE-601).
